66-Year-Old Prediction of World Ending on Nov 13, 2026, Gains Traction

A scientific paper published in 1960, which originally discussed the pressure of growing human populations on limited resources, is now being discussed as a prediction for the end of the world on November 13, 2026. The discussion has gained traction, with some linking it to artificial intelligence (AI). The original paper did not present this as a definitive doomsday date but rather as a consequence of population and resource dynamics.
